opinion_zh: 按 SCOPE_MATRIX.md 明列的稿内查询域、原整数算术和对应包络，可接受 P2.1。最终联合检验实际装入 143 个项目模块。三个新增 owner 有 118 个唯一声明，与原 140 个 owner 的 18,581 个声明无交集。

accepted: Documented five-root rational sieve, Suzuki and Buchstab queries on their stated domains
Original signed P160 division with positive divisor lower endpoint and source-form P160 interval operations
Compatibility of these interfaces in the accepted joint environment
outside: Historical E2 qpow/box/Repr/decision-instance VM equality and saved endpoints
Identity of every serialized table or historical masked row
Consumer-specific P2.4/P2.7/P2.9 or P5 charges and totals
Completion of P2 or the main theorem

log: The summand consumes the previous odd power before it advances. All upper divisions keep n+d−1 with positive denominators.
Factor two is applied at the end. The original upper-only tail equals one W224 unit and dominates the accepted rational remainder for all rational 1 ≤ q ≤ 2.
Both scaled integer outputs enclose Real.log by RationalLogCertificate.check_sound. The two Lean execution models agree. Both Python and the public Lean contract give (0,1) at q=1.
p160: All four signed endpoint quotients are divided directly. The denominator hypotheses guarantee strict positivity of both endpoints.
The decoded integer outputs equal the rational interval quotient rounded once at P160. Containment uses the actual input enclosures.
For 2/3 the direct upper integer ends in 8651 and rounding a reciprocal first gives 8652. Both were independently reproduced from the frozen source.

initial_acceptance.scope_of_failure: All seven verification commands exited zero. The wrapper rejected a single oversized transfer after writing the intact archive. Two retrieval jobs returned the same archive bytes.
initial_acceptance.global_joint_result_at_this_revision: Four generated-name collisions with old owners. Superseded for final joint scope.

finite_log_comparison.checks: Both returned integer endpoints, canonical input numerator and denominator, row order, and all 20,290 distinct arguments. The grid contribution is a mask-independent geometric superset. No universal VM claim.

resolved_findings.resolution: Stdin transport and bounded stages. Oversized resulting archive was recovered by verified split transport.

resolved_findings.resolution: The five original driver/template files are digest-pinned. Reviewed primary files were compared to the recovered acceptance bytes for each revision.

resolved_findings.resolution: The joint overlay holds all 143 project modules linked to pinned physical objects.

resolved_findings.issue: Four generated equation declarations collided with owners in the old closure
resolved_findings.repair: Only scale_eq, the two rounding branches and contains_iff proof bodies changed. The public types, imports, arithmetic, and every retained declaration type are unchanged. No names were added.

division_refresh.fresh_credit: Only the division owner and division public contract ran afresh. Original log receipts and the finite comparison are byte-bound reuses.

review_method: Independently inspected frozen source and proofs, compiler and stock replay records, raw audit rows, complete declaration types, archives and joint log. Reconstructed the historical joint reference from four frozen old assets. Checked both sets of source and object bindings and the ancestry of the reused comparison. The historical 140-owner proofs and remote processes were not rerun by this reviewer.
limits: The joint runner verifies selected project objects and special native facets by hash. Other external modules are compared by recorded path and pinned environment. Intermediate receipts retain their stage-specific full_p2_1_complete=false. Publication and board changes are separate operations.
